reason: The measure-vs-render contract (acceptance criterion #9) is a component-level DOM fact, not a browser flow — pinned by src/lib/components/typing/TypingSurface.svelte.spec.ts's 'across all three reading fonts' block (both halves: resolves to exactly CHARS_PER_LINE ch, and never fits fewer than CHARS_PER_LINE characters on the first rendered line, looped over sans/serif/mono). The dual-budget arithmetic itself (chunkParagraphs closing on whichever of chars/lines binds first) is pure and pinned by src/lib/chunking/chunker.spec.ts and measure.spec.ts. Nothing here has a meaningful E2E shape beyond what those already prove.

reason: The scroll math is pure (src/lib/components/typing/teleprompter.ts) and fully pinned by teleprompter.spec.ts's computeTranslateY cases (band entry, both clamps). The DOM half is a single $effect that only ever feeds it real measurements; asserting a translateY pixel value through a real browser would measure font-metric and line-height rounding rather than the feature, which is exactly the class of E2E flake the pure-math split exists to avoid needing (spec #32 Feature Brief §11 R7).
